title: Dog Grooming Guide Printable | At Home Dog Grooming PDF | Nail Trimming Guide | Grooming Schedule by Coat Type | Instant Download
description:
Groom your dog at home with confidence, and turn nail trims and bath time into calm, positive routines.

Professional grooming is great, but the care in between visits happens at home. This step-by-step guide shows you how to brush, bathe, trim nails, clean ears and care for teeth the low-stress way, with a schedule matched to your dog's coat type.

WHAT'S INSIDE (13 pages, US Letter PDF)
- Coat types and brushing tools: smooth, double, long, curly and wire coats
- Brushing technique step by step, plus shedding season survival
- Bathing step by step: prep, water temperature, shampoo choice, rinsing and drying without the drama
- Nail trimming: understanding the quick, clippers vs. grinders, and what to do if you nick it
- Ear cleaning basics and teeth brushing routine, with warning signs worth a vet visit
- Paw care and seasonal grooming tips
- Making grooming stress-free: reading stress signals and a step-by-step desensitization method
- Grooming schedule by coat type, with space for your dog's custom schedule
- Printable monthly grooming checklist and daily teeth-brushing tracker

WHO IT'S FOR
- Dog owners who want to stretch the time between professional grooming appointments
- Owners of dogs who get anxious about paws, baths or brushes
- New puppy owners building good handling habits early
- Anyone who wants a simple, repeatable at-home care routine

2. Download instantly - the PDF is available under Purchases & Reviews right after payment, and Etsy emails you a download link.
3. Print at home on US Letter (8.5 x 11 in), or fill it in on a tablet with any PDF annotation app.
